San Diego, CA, USA
  
  
Ever wonder how it feels to have hundreds of thousands of users counting on you to keep Amazon secure without slowing anyone down? Amazon Security's Access Review team is the group for you! We own the systems 250,000+ Amazonians use to review and right-size the access they hold across Teams, Bindles, Hostclasses, and Permission Groups. We sit at the intersection of security, compliance, and developer productivity, connected to nearly every part of Amazon's worldwide service-oriented architecture. Whether you're passionate about building highly scalable and reliable systems in the cloud, or you're a software developer who likes to solve interesting and complex business problems, Access Review is the place for you.
  
  
Our mission is to enforce industry-leading least privilege at Amazon scale: every person and service should have exactly the access they need, and nothing more. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to design and build large-scale, high-impact Access Management systems with company-wide reach, and to help lead the next chapter of that mission, applying AI and machine learning to the hardest problem in the space, determining the right level of least-privilege access automatically. You will build the intelligence that surfaces unused and excessive permissions, recommends precise access decisions, and continuously drives the fleet toward least privilege with minimal human toil. There is ample opportunity to innovate and deliver outcomes that measurably reduce Amazon's security risk.
  
  
You will collaborate with the leadership team to drive key engineering and business decisions that shape the access experience for the entire Amazon developer community. You will contribute to all parts of the software development and deployment lifecycle across multiple products, including design, implementation, documentation, testing, deployment, and operations.
  
  
Successful candidates for this position will have strong software engineering fundamentals such as object-oriented design, algorithms, data structures, and a good grasp of advanced systems concepts and design. Experience applying AI/ML to real-world problems is a plus, but not required, we'll help you grow into it. They must possess strong verbal and written communication skills, be self-driven, and consistently deliver high-quality results. They need to really enjoy working closely with their peers within a group of very talented engineers and builders.
  
  
This position involves on-call responsibilities. We don't like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don't get paged for the same issue twice. Come build with us!
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Our team is responsible for building and maintaining multiple services that are critical for access management across Amazon. You'll work with your teammates, peers in our organization, stakeholders and customers from all around the company to define the access management experience.

**Description**
Do you want to build the ML models that power every compliance verdict customers and auditors rely on? We are building a new Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) service at AWS where every action — human or agent — is recorded, assessed, and provably governed, continuously and at any scale.
  
  
As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will own the Natural Language Inference (NLI) model at the center of our compliance engine: fine-tuning, calibrating, and monitoring it in production. You will also design the science behind framework decomposition, evidence auto-linking, and a new agent-context system that tackles retrieval, grounding, and hallucination measurement for AI agents. Your work will directly shape the accuracy and trustworthiness of every customer-visible result we produce.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the production NLI model end-to-end: fine-tune, promote, calibrate thresholds, and monitor for drift to ensure accurate compliance verdicts across frameworks.
* Design and implement framework decomposition pipelines that translate compliance controls into NLI hypotheses, including enrichment and per-framework threshold calibration.
* Build and improve the evidence auto-linking system using ranking, embedding, and reranking techniques, tuning precision-recall tradeoffs and addressing OCR quality challenges.
* Drive the quality flywheel by establishing labeling standards, designing offline and online evaluation methods, orchestrating retraining cycles, and ensuring privacy-safe data handling.
* Research and develop the agent-context capability — retrieval and representation of lifecycle signals, cross-framework knowledge, memory, grounding, and hallucination measurement — collaborating with engineering pods to bring these models into production.

A day in the life
  
  
You will split your time between collaborative and heads-down work. On the collaborative side, you will partner with several pods of software development engineers in an Agile cadence — aligning on data collection needs, sharing experiment results, and integrating models into production services. On the heads-down side, you will dig into model training runs, analyze evaluation metrics, and iterate on threshold tuning until the numbers meet the bar. Your work is roadmap-driven, giving you the space to plan experiments methodically while still responding to new framework onboarding requests as they arise.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our team builds the AI and ML systems behind AWS Governance, Risk, & Compliance service, where science is not auxiliary — it is the core. Every customer-visible compliance result flows through models our scientists create and maintain. We are investing in next-generation capabilities including observability and governance for AI agents, and the multi-quarter Agent Context initiative is an organization-defining program that will need technical leaders.
  
  
Growth here is tangible. You will own the full model lifecycle from training through production monitoring, develop rare expertise at the intersection of ML and compliance, and have a clear path to expand your scope into technical leadership as the service scales.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of building models for business application experience
* 2+ years of programming in Java, C++, Python or related language experience
* 2+ years of hands-on predictive modeling and large data analysis experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PhD in computer science, machine learning, engineering, or related fields
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
* Experience with one of the following areas: machine learning technologies, Reinforcement Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP) or related applications
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
* Extensive experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment.
* Experience with building agentic systems using LLMs and familiar with common agentic framework such as Strands Agent, LangGraph, etc.
* Solid knowledge on LLM techniques and experience with LLM post-training.

**Description**
Amazon Advertising is one of Amazon's fastest growing and most profitable businesses, responsible for defining and delivering AI-powered solutions that transform how advertisers make strategic decisions. We deliver billions of ad impressions and process massive volumes of advertiser data every single day. You'll work with us to pioneer breakthrough approaches in how AI agents access and reason over real-time advertiser data at scale.
  
  
The Campaign Management team is responsible for capturing inputs for advertisers to control their advertising efforts. You can think of our team as the brain and nervous system of all the advertisements you see on amazon.com. We build large scale, high velocity distributed systems to service 100’s of millions of API requests per day, steam data at PB scale, process business logic on tight latency budgets, all while streaming and the data at high fidelity to 20+ other services to perform other critical advertising functions. We stand up world class CI/CD pipelines to deploy our service automating infrastructure provisioning, high volume load testing and first-rate monitoring so our engineers can keep their heads down inventing for our advertisers. Our problem space covers concurrent workflows across distributed systems (linearizability, eventual consistency), big data problems (propagation delay, ordering and hygiene) and performance (search optimization). Our team uses the latest AWS products and services to solve our problems including but not limited to: ECS, Fargate, EC2, EMR, Lambda, Kafka, Elastic Search, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, Cloud watch, CDK, Cloud Formation and many more.
  
  
We are using generative AI and agentic systems to help advertising agents provide instant, strategic advice to millions of advertisers. You will need to invent new techniques for global ads experience, agent orchestration, and context optimization to ensure we're delivering accurate, trustworthy insights with minimal latency and token consumption. You'll create feedback loops to ensure our solutions are constantly evaluating themselves and improving.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and implement scalable architectures for APIs serving millions of advertisers at thousands of transactions per second
* Build Model Context Protocol (MCP) server infrastructure—an emerging standard for AI agent-data interaction—that delivers advertiser context with sub-second latency and minimal token consumption
* Establish system design patterns and best practices for global ads experience at scale

**Basic Qualifications**
